label: prf:jones-mobius-diagonal
title: Proof of jones mobius diagonal
html:
Proof. Proof of jones mobius diagonal

Proof. The kernel collapse (Frobenius–Hopf kernel) gives K_q(s,t) \to 1/r^2 on the diagonal; its coincidence residue is the fundamental two-point contact C(\varrho), which by the Jones–Markov identity (Jones–Markov trace) is the single-element Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_K)) = J_K(q). The categorical Möbius energy is, by definition, the regularized two-point integral with this contact removed — the O'Hara / Freedman–He–Wang Hadamard finite part. Rearranging the renormalization identity E_{\mathrm{cat}} = T_{\mathrm{reg}} - C gives C = T_{\mathrm{reg}} - E_{\mathrm{cat}}, that is J_K = T_{\mathrm{reg}} - E_{\mathrm{cat}}. The off-diagonal remainder retains the comultiplication's fusion coefficients N^\lambda_{\mu\nu}, which the single-element trace does not resolve; hence the embedding is strict. \qquad\blacksquare

Surreal reading. Under the surreal lift (Möbius renormalization) the regularized two-point I_1 and the contact term I_2 are both infinite surreals of \mathrm{ord}_\omega = +1 with the same leading coefficient; the shared \omega^{+1} divergence is this contact / self-energy, and E_{\mathrm{cat}} = \mathrm{std}(I_1 - I_2) is the appreciable remainder. The lemma identifies that shared divergence with J_K(q).

Scope. This is the fundamental (N=2) base of the embedding. The N-coloured contacts form the coloured-Markov-trace family \mathrm{tr}_M^{(N)}(\rho(\beta_K)) whose N \to \infty logarithmic growth rate is the hyperbolic volume (Kashaev volume–density); the present lemma is the N=2 rung on which that tower is built, not a claim about the limit.
